title: Beyond Preset Identities: How Agents Form Stances and Boundaries in Generative Societies

bias_targets.methodology: Using a mixed-methods framework combining computational virtual ethnography and quantitative socio-cognitive profiling to measure 'Innate Value Bias' (IVB). The methodology involves embedding human researchers into a generative multi-agent community, applying controlled discursive interventions (environmental vs. economic, rational vs. emotional), and calculating the agents' deviation from preset identities to reveal endogenous progressive or 'liberal elite' tendencies.
